runtimeResult.message: Headless execution requires clarification before a repository plan can be created.

promptUnderstanding.reply: I need the intended calculator layout or a precise description of the defect before repository work can be scoped safely.
promptUnderstanding.conversationSummary: The request permits changes only to styles.css, requires package metadata to remain unchanged, protects .env, .git/**, and bun.lock, and requests bun test when appropriate. The intended calculator layout is not specified.

refinedBrief.goal: Correct the calculator layout by editing only styles.css.
deliverables: A focused styles.css change that implements the confirmed layout correction.
Package metadata and all other files left unchanged.
constraints: Do not modify .env, .git/**, bun.lock, package metadata, or any other file.
Run bun test when it is an appropriate available validation command.
acceptanceCriteria: The confirmed calculator layout issue is resolved.
nonGoals: Changing application logic, markup, scripts, dependencies, package metadata, lockfiles, environment files, or Git files.

questions.prompt: What should the corrected calculator layout look like, or what is currently wrong?
questions.rationale: The requested visual outcome is not defined, so changing CSS now would require guessing the intended layout.

options.label: Describe the defect (Recommended)
options.description: Provide the current behavior and the expected layout, including relevant viewport sizes if applicable.

options.label: Provide a reference
options.description: Share a screenshot, mockup, or existing design reference that defines the intended layout.
